title: Bands and privileges
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Hams transmit inside bands: set ranges of frequencies. Six meters runs from 50 to 54 megahertz.
lines.say: Hams transmit inside bands: set ranges of frequencies. Six meters runs from fifty to fifty-four megahertz.
lines.label: ranges, not anywhere

lines.caption: Two meters runs from 144 to 148 megahertz. 146.52 megahertz is inside it.
lines.say: Two meters runs from one forty-four to one forty-eight megahertz. One forty-six point five two megahertz is inside it.
lines.label: 144 to 148 MHz

lines.caption: On HF, a Technician may talk by voice only on 10 meters, from 28.3 to 28.5 megahertz.
lines.say: On H F, a Technician may talk by voice only on ten meters, from twenty-eight point three to twenty-eight point five megahertz.
lines.label: HF voice: 10 meters

lines.caption: Power has limits too: 200 watts on HF, and 1500 watts above 30 megahertz.
lines.say: Power has limits too: two hundred watts on H F, and fifteen hundred watts above thirty megahertz.
lines.label: 200 W and 1500 W

lines.caption: Where hams share a band as a secondary service, other stations come first.
lines.label: others come first
